tools.name: upgrade
tools.description: Show your current Misar.Blog plan, how much of each quota you have left, and what upgrading unlocks. Call it any time — not only after hitting a limit. Set open=true to open the checkout page in your browser.

tools.name: get_profile
tools.description: Get your Misar.Blog creator profile

tools.name: get_analytics_summary
tools.description: Get analytics summary (views, revenue, subscribers) for a time period

tools.name: list_my_articles
tools.description: List your articles on Misar.Blog

tools.name: get_article
tools.description: Get a single article by slug, including full markdown content

tools.name: publish_article
tools.description: Publish a new article (or schedule it) on Misar.Blog

tools.name: create_draft
tools.description: Save an article as a draft on Misar.Blog (for review before publishing)

tools.name: update_article
tools.description: Update the title, body, or tags of an existing article or draft. Only the fields you pass are changed; omitted fields keep their current values.

tools.name: search_articles
tools.description: Search PUBLISHED articles across Misar.Blog by keyword, tag, or author — including other creators' work. Use list_my_articles for your own drafts and unpublished posts.

tools.name: research_topic
tools.description: Research a topic and get AI-generated insights, sources, and a content outline. Useful before writing an article.

tools.name: generate_title_seo
tools.description: Generate 5 SEO/AEO/GEO-optimized article titles from a topic or keyword prompt. Targets high-volume, low-competition long-tail keywords. Optimized for Google, AI answer engines (ChatGPT, Perplexity, Claude), Google AI Overviews, and AI search experiences. Each title includes a keyword strategy hint.

tools.name: suggest_titles
tools.description: Generate 5 compelling, SEO-friendly article title options from your existing article content. Use generate_title_seo instead if you want to target specific keywords or have not written content yet.

tools.name: generate_cover_image
tools.description: Generate a cover image using AI and upload it to the Misar.Blog CDN

tools.name: get_series
tools.description: List all your series on Misar.Blog

tools.name: create_series
tools.description: Create a new series to group related articles

tools.name: add_to_series
tools.description: Add an existing article to a series

tools.name: list_comments
tools.description: Get public comments for an article. Rate-limited by IP — no API key required.

tools.name: get_follow_status
tools.description: Get public follow status and follower count for a user by their profile UUID. No API key required.

tools.name: list_newsletter_subscribers
tools.description: Get your newsletter subscriber list. Requires API key authentication.

tools.name: list_newsletter_issues
tools.description: Get your sent and scheduled newsletter issues. Requires API key authentication.

tools.name: get_reactions
tools.description: Get reaction counts and your reactions for an article. Requires API key.

tools.name: add_reaction
tools.description: Add a reaction to an article. No-ops if already reacted. Requires API key.

tools.name: remove_reaction
tools.description: Remove a specific reaction from an article. Requires API key.

prompts.name: draft_article
prompts.description: Write a complete, SEO-optimised article draft and save it to Misar.Blog.

arguments.name: topic
arguments.description: Topic, title idea, or detailed outline

prompts.name: improve_seo
prompts.description: Audit an article for SEO/AEO/GEO and apply the improvements.

arguments.name: article_slug
arguments.description: Slug of the article to analyse

prompts.name: write_newsletter
prompts.description: Draft a newsletter issue from recent published articles.

prompts.name: article_ideas
prompts.description: Generate article ideas grounded in what has and has not been covered.

arguments.name: theme
arguments.description: Theme or niche to generate ideas within

prompts.name: social_caption
prompts.description: Write platform-specific promotional captions for an article.

arguments.name: article_slug
arguments.description: Slug of the article to promote

prompts.name: optimize_headline
prompts.description: Generate and rank stronger headline options for an article.

arguments.name: topic
arguments.description: Topic, if the article does not exist yet

prompts.name: series_plan
prompts.description: Plan a multi-part article series and set it up on Misar.Blog.

prompts.name: engagement_report
prompts.description: Summarise blog performance and recommend what to do next.

resources.name: Creator profile
resources.description: Your Misar.Blog profile — username, display name, bio, and payout status. Read this to get the author URL and handle right before writing anything public.

resources.name: Recent published articles
resources.description: Your 20 most recent published articles. Useful as a style and coverage reference so a new draft neither repeats nor contradicts existing work.

resources.name: Open drafts
resources.description: Your unpublished drafts, so work in progress can be resumed rather than restarted.

resources.name: Article series
resources.description: Your series and the articles in each, in order.

resources.name: Analytics summary
resources.description: Views, revenue, and subscriber counts for the last 30 days — the baseline for any performance question.
